text:
deploy-bot: Deployed gateway v3.2.0 to us-west-2 canary (10%). Starting post-deploy smoke run: smoke-probe/gateway-health, synthetic-fanout, kv-prefill.
alice: kicking off curl/warmup + synthetic sequences now, will post quick numbers.
ben: seeing a short burst of 503s to /v1/gateway during first minute of traffic shift, maybe backend warmup.
carla: smoke-probe reports p95=480ms, error-rate 1.8% over 2m, threshold p95>300ms -> alerting infra @infra-sre
infra-sre: investigating batcher/worker spin-up, queue length peaked on pool gateway-fanout-1; increasing warmup concurrency.
oncall-sre-bot: Incident INC-2026 created (gateway warmup spike) — paging oncall.
dave: suggestion: hold rollout at 10% and bump batcher workers rather than rollback; we have rollout pin ready.
emma: agree with hold. If p95 > 600ms for 10m we rollback to v3.1.9. Otherwise tune and re-check.
alice: quick curl check: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://gateway-internal.usw2/health` -> "200 0.28"
ben: after bumping batcher parallelism p95 dropped to 220ms and error-rate back to 0.2% :white_check_mark:
carla: smoke green after 11m, logging note: transient fanout warmup; added autoscale warmup config to rollout doc.
deploy-bot: Rolling canary to 50% now per rollout config. Monitoring for 15m.
emma: adding release note blurb: "gateway v3.2.0 — improved fanout handling; initial warmup may cause brief latency spike, fixed with autoscale warmup tuning." 
alice: closing thread, will append probe graphs to release review doc and update change window notes (midnight UTC maintenance window).
